`enum UIDataPopup.PopupTransition`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataPopup.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataPopup.java)

Which steps of the pop transition a popup plays.

## Description

A transition set with [`UI.transition`](/reference/ui/ui/#UI-property-transition) replaces the one these values give.

## Learn more

- [Transitions](/use/learn/style-and-motion/transitions/#choose-what-a-popup-plays)

<a id="UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [isIn](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-method-isIn)() | If `true`, the popup plays a transition when it opens. |
| `boolean` | [isOut](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-method-isOut)() | If `true`, the popup plays a transition when it closes. |
| `boolean` | [isActive](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-method-isActive)() | If `true`, the popup plays a transition on opening, on closing or both. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`NONE`](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-value-NONE) | The popup opens and closes at once. |
| [`IN`](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-value-IN) | The popup grows in when it opens and closes at once. |
| [`OUT`](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-value-OUT) | The popup opens at once and shrinks out when it closes. |
| [`IN_OUT`](#UIDataPopup-PopupTransition-value-IN_OUT) | The popup grows in when it opens and shrinks out when it closes. |
